examples.title: Same protein, different dialect
examples.takeaway: The amino acid remains Arg while the preferred synonymous codon changes sharply between organisms.
examples.description: At position 38, DeCodon assigns different codon preferences to the same fixed E. coli sequence when only the organism token changes.

examples.title: Strong and weak organism signals
examples.takeaway: E. coli produces sharp preferences; B. subtilis is often much flatter.
examples.description: The model learned some organisms better than others. Compare the entropy and bar shapes instead of hiding that heterogeneity.

examples.title: Biology resolves at different layers
examples.takeaway: Organism identity is available early, positional context peaks mid-model, and amino-acid information builds late.
examples.description: These curves are independent linear probes measured on DeCodon hidden states. They are evidence about depth, not fabricated per-position J-lens output.
